mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near City Hall with an air quality index of 55, which is in the moderate range. Under the light of the full moon, our overnight temperature will drop to 62 degrees with no rain predicted for the rest of the night.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker design contest to boost civic engagement. Students in grades K through 12 submitted original artwork, and the community is now invited to vote for their favorite designs online at the city website through August 7 to determine which stickers will be used in November.

There is plenty to do around town. Today, you can head to Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company for trivia. Tomorrow, the Downtown Farmer's Market kicks off at Hometown Junction Park, and we also have Wednesday trivia at The Bogey Factory and pizza and pitchers at Lake Lou-ee.
Regarding local activity, on July 26, officers responded to a hit and run incident near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane where an 83 year old driver was cited for the crash.

Today's flavor of the day is Georgia Peach, and since we are open until 10 PM, you have plenty of time to stop by. Also, don't forget you can find Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 1:30 PM to 4:15 PM.
